== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|A shield [[amulet]], also known as a protection [[amulet]], is a defensive magical item worn around the neck. Typically glowing orange, these amulets function by projecting an invisible sphere of protection around the user's body. This barrier becomes visible as a burst of light or a shimmering field only when it is struck by projectiles, such as bullets, [[plasma bolt|plasma bolts]], or debris. While the [[amulet]] provides a vital layer of defense that can complement other magical protections like an enchanted mantle, it has limitations; directed attacks or powerful spells can overwhelm and crack the shield, sometimes causing the [[amulet]] to explode or deplete its energy. These items are often crafted from shield crystals, with [[fortress]] crystals being a common material used to create them. While relatively easy to find, the effectiveness of an [[amulet]] depends heavily on the quality of its material and the strength of its [[enchantment]]. Users may attempt to upgrade their amulets by improving the magic rather than replacing the crystal itself. In high-stakes combat, a shield [[amulet]] serves as an essential component of a multi-layered defense system, helping to anchor protective spells and mitigate damage from heavy physical or magical strikes.}}
